Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The System Event message is used to signal key market or data feed control events.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time stamp

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Denotes the type of event for which the message is being generated.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq PSX disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in its market center system.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the directory message was generated. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue.

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For Nasdaq-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue.

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if Nasdaq system limits order entry for issue.

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Issue Sub Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in Nasdaq systems in a live/production, test, or demo state.

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the Nasdaq security is set up for IPO release. This field is intended to help Nasdaq market participant firms comply with FINRA Rule 5131(b).

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument.

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product (ETP).

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index. Note: Leverage Factor of 1 indicates the ETP is NOT leveraged.

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and underlying index. This field is used for LULD Tier I price band calculation purposes.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time Stamp.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for issue for which the stock trading action message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the issue.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reflects the Market Ops or MarketWatch code for the trading state change.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction (Rule 201) status for an issue: a full pre-opening spin for Nasdaq-listed issues and intraday status changes.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the market participant position message was generated

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: MWCB Decline Level Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients what the daily MWCB breach points are set to for the current trading day.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the MWCB Decline Level message was generated

Field.Name: Level 1
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 1 Value.

Field.Name: Level 2
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 2 Value.

Field.Name: Level 3
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 3 Value.

Message.Name: MWCB Status Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients when a MWCB has breached one of the established levels.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the MWCB Breaker Status message was generated

Field.Name: Breached Level
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level that was breached.

Message.Name: Quotation Message
Message.Description: PSX BBO will broadcast a real-time update every time that the exchange's best bid and offer quote is updated during the trading day.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time stamp

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the PSX market center system issue identifier for which the PSX BBO quotation message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the stock.

Field.Name: PSX Best Bid Price
Field.Description: Denotes the PSX best bid price, the highest price for market buy order(s) in the PSX system.

Field.Name: PSX Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the PSX market center system at the PSX best bid Price.

Field.Name: PSX Best Offer Price
Field.Description: Denotes the PSX exchange's best offer price, the lowest price for market sell order(s) in the PSX system.

Field.Name: PSX Best Offer Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the PSX market center system at the PSX Best Offer Price.

Message.Name: NextShares Quotation Message
Message.Description: This version of the Quotation message format will be used for Exchange Traded Managed Funds (NextShares). For this asset class, Nasdaq will support both Proxy Price and Net Asset Value (NAV) premium/discount amount for the best bid and offer. Not currently supported for the PSX market (grayed out in the specification).

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the message was generated

Field.Name: NextShares Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the NextShares symbol in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the stock.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Best Bid Proxy Price
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq best bid price for NextShares in proxy price format.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq market center system at the Nasdaq best bid price.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Best Bid NAV Premium Discount Amount
Field.Description: Denotes premium or discount amount to the NAV reflected in the Nasdaq best bid. Please note: This is a signed (+/-) field.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Best Offer Proxy Price
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq best offer for the NextShares in proxy price format.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Best Offer Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq market center system at the Nasdaq best offer price.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Best Offer NAV Premium Discount Amount
Field.Description: Denotes the premium or discount amount to the NAV reflected in the Nasdaq best offer. Please note: this is a signed (+/-) field.

Value.Name: Start of Transmissions
Value.Description: Denotes that PSX BBO has started its daily transmission schedule.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that PSX is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: It indicates that PSX is now closed and will not accept any new orders today.

Value.Name: End of Transmissions
Value.Description: Denotes that PSX BBO has completed its daily transmission schedule.
